risks.title: Economic Downturn and Recession
risks.score_rationale: Commercial real estate transaction volume and valuations are cyclical and highly sensitive to economic conditions. A recession would directly reduce property values and transaction activity. (default score pending refinement)

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: Higher interest rates reduce financing activity and property valuations, impacting both financing fee revenue and overall transaction volumes. (default score pending refinement)

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: Commercial real estate brokerage market is competitive with multiple national and regional firms. Market share could be lost to competitors. (default score pending refinement)

risks.title: Dependence on Independent Contractors
risks.score_rationale: Sales professionals are primarily independent contractors who can terminate relationships and move to competitors, creating retention and revenue risks. (default score pending refinement)

risks.title: Credit and Counterparty Risk
risks.score_rationale: Company has guarantee obligations of $444.9M for loans through strategic alliance. Loan defaults could result in losses. (default score pending refinement)

risks.title: Regulatory Changes
risks.score_rationale: Changes in real estate regulations, licensing requirements or securities laws could increase compliance costs. (default score pending refinement)
